messages:
Maria T: Quick Q — using Node SDK against our private endpoint behind a corporate HTTP CONNECT proxy. Streaming completions start then drop after ~30s with a socket reset. Config looks like: baseURL=https://private.redwood.internal, proxy=http://corp-proxy:3128, API key in header. Anyone seen this?

Dylan H: Are you doing mTLS to the private endpoint or plain TLS? Most CONNECT proxies will close tunnels if they see no data for a bit.

Maria T: Plain TLS (customer requested no client certs). The private endpoint sits behind an internal ALB. We can add keepalives but wanted to check SDK expectations first.

Raj P: ALBs commonly have an idle timeout of 60s by default, but proxies sometimes have 30s. If the proxy closes the CONNECT, the SDK sees a reset. Do you see an HTTP 200 CONNECT then nothing?

Maria T: infra logs show CONNECT succeeded, then TCP FIN from proxy at the drop. infra-bot pasted a snippet: 

infra-bot: [proxy-logs] 2025-03-10T15:12:03Z INFO CONNECT /private.redwood.internal:443 200 in=0 out=0 
infra-bot: [proxy-logs] 2025-03-10T15:12:33Z WARN connection closed due to idle timeout

Sophia L: Two quick fixes: 1) enable TCP keepalive on the SDK socket, 2) turn on chunked transfer and send a tiny heartbeat (newline) every 25s from client side. The SDK exposes socket options and a streaming keepAlive interval in the Node client — set streaming.keepAlive=20000.

Dylan H: Also double-check that the proxy is doing a pure TCP tunnel (CONNECT) and not an intercepting proxy that inspects TLS. Interception will break streaming.

Maria T: Is there a config flag in the SDK for CONNECT vs proxy tunneling? Our code uses generic `proxy.url`.

Raj P: In Node SDK v1.12 we added `proxy.tunnel: true|false` (default true for http proxies). If you must talk through a SOCKS or corporate forwarder, set proxy.tunnel=false and use the matching agent. Example snippet: 

```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({
  baseURL: 'https://private.redwood.internal',
  apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY,
  proxy: { url: 'http://corp-proxy:3128', tunnel: true },
  streaming: { keepAlive: 20000, retryOnDisconnect: false }
});
```

Sophia L: Note the `retryOnDisconnect: false` for streaming. By default we had a retry policy that will try to re-open the request which is unsafe for non-idempotent streaming completions. If you need resumable streams, switch to our resumable-chunks protocol.

Maria T: OK will try keepAlive + tunnel true + disable retry. One more: does setting a custom baseURL change the SDK TLS SNI behavior? Could SNI mismatch cause early closes?

Dylan H: The SDK sets SNI to the hostname from baseURL. If your proxy rewrites host headers, make sure the CONNECT target matches the certificate hostname. ALB cert must match private.redwood.internal. If you had IP in CONNECT and hostname in TLS, some proxies/ALBs will close.

Maria T: Good catch. I'll update CONNECT to use private.redwood.internal and flip keepAlive on. Will report back. Thanks! :heart:

Raj P: If you still see resets, capture a tcpdump and paste the three-way teardown — that helped us root-cause a similar issue with a NAT idle timer.

Sophia L: Also add a metric for streaming.disconnect.reason in the Console; we added parsing for proxy-close vs client-close last quarter.

Maria T: Will do. If anything fails I'll reopen. Appreciate the quick help.
